items.title: Item Templates
items.emptyDesc: Add your first item template to get started.
items.tipAttachmentSlots: Slots this item exposes for other items to attach into (e.g. scope, magazine, grip).

loadouts.title: Loadout Templates
loadouts.editItemDesc: Update the quantity, slot, or behaviour for this entry.
loadouts.addItemDesc: Select an item template and configure its spawn properties.
loadouts.noSlotsDefined: No attachment slots defined. Add them in Settings → Attachment Slots.
loadouts.emptyDesc: Create a loadout to define what a character spawns with.
loadouts.placeholderTagline: e.g. Basic loadout for city NPCs
loadouts.placeholderDesc: Detailed notes about this loadout's intended use…
loadouts.tipTagline: One-line description shown in list previews.
loadouts.tipApplyOnSpawn: Equip and add items immediately when the NPC/player spawns.
loadouts.tipRandomiseQty: Roll item quantities within their min/max range at spawn time.
loadouts.tipAutoEquipPass: Run an auto-equip pass after all items are added.
loadouts.tipItems: Each entry defines which item to add, its quantity, starting durability, whether to auto-equip, and an optional preferred slot.
loadouts.tipSlotAssignments: Maps each attachment slot to a specific item in the Composition list.

crafting.title: Recipe Templates
crafting.addIngredientDesc: Showing items in the Material category or with a Material tag segment.
crafting.emptyDesc: Create a recipe to define how items are crafted.
crafting.tipResultItem: Only items with the Craftable flag are shown.
crafting.tipQualityLabel: Short grade descriptor shown next to the result name.
crafting.tipQtyMax: Random roll between Min and Max on craft success.
crafting.tipStation: Station the player must be at to craft this recipe.
crafting.tipDuration: Time in seconds the crafting animation takes.
crafting.tipGroups: Each group is a list of ingrediences that result to target item to be created. Add groups to represent alternative material sets.

settings.title: Title
settings.colourDesc: Used for badges, borders, and rarity-themed UI accents.
settings.actionKeyDesc: Programmatic identifier used in game logic (e.g. Equip, Repair).
settings.iconDesc: Lucide icon name rendered in the item action chip (e.g. shield, trash, eye).
settings.tooltipDesc: Short description shown on hover in the player-facing UI.
settings.slotNameDesc: Display name for this equipment slot (e.g. Primary, Head, Accessory).
settings.slotTagsDesc: Gameplay tags that identify this slot (e.g. Slot.Primary, Slot.Head).
settings.stationNameDesc: Display name shown in recipe requirements (e.g. Forge, Loom).
settings.stationTagDesc: Single gameplay tag identifying this station (e.g. Station.Forge).
settings.tagsDesc: Gameplay / data tags applied to every item in this category.

common.deleteConfirmDesc: "{{name}}" will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.
